title: Citizen module manifest
description: Schema for modules/<module_id>/module.yaml (ARCHITECTURE.md § 2.2). Versioned with the core_api contract; this revision is core_api 3.4 (3.0 plus the optional `errata` key, WP-110, in 3.1, and the optional `plain_language` key, WP-122, in 3.2, public intake_schema/service deadline support in 3.3, and receipt/event deadline semantics/civil calendar SDK in 3.4; additive, so every 3.0/3.1/3.2 manifest stays valid). The registry additionally refuses an enabled module whose core_api range does not admit the running SDK version, and (since WP-93) any manifest that declares a file missing from, or outside of, its module directory. Content sections are optional: stub modules (tier experimental) ship only the sections they carry.

id.description: Stable module key; equals the legal_area value; never renamed.

tier.description: Lifecycle tier (ARCHITECTURE.md § 2.5); drives the D-037 default enablement.

corpus.description: Path of the module corpus scope file, relative to the module directory.

fristen.description: Path of the deadline spec file (ARCHITECTURE.md § 2.3).

document_templates.description: Action-draft templates, slot definitions and generator selection rules rendered by the core document renderer.

intake.description: Intake tables keyed by area key (routing keywords, synonyms), catch-all flag, presets.

intake_schema.description: Optional public JSON Schema in YAML for module-specific confirmed intake facts (core_api 3.3).

prompts.description: Stage prompt profile (persona, statutes, terminology anchors) or {inherit: <module_id>}; applies to every area key the module owns (id + legacy_aliases).

errata.description: Errata file (citizen-module-errata-v1.0, app/modules/errata.schema.json; WP-110, core_api 3.1). Modules declaring it need core_api >=3.1.

plain_language.description: Plain-language copy (citizen-plain-copy-v1.0, app/plain/copy.schema.json; WP-122, core_api 3.2): one file per language key (de, de-LS, en, ...) plus the optional plain-language goldset checked by eval.plain_eval. Modules declaring it need core_api >=3.2.

legacy_aliases.description: Legacy v2.0.0 area keys that resolve to this module (D-038), e.g. erbrecht declares ["schenkungsrecht"].
